name: VOLT Dance Club
creator: DigitrevX
description: VOLT Dance Club is a highly detailed mega-club world created by DigitrevX, featuring custom LED wall visuals, dynamic lighting, multiple bars, private rooms, a dart game, and jacuzzis. It's built to feel like a genuine high-end nightclub experience and even includes an optional RTX ray-tracing graphics mode for compatible Nvidia GPUs. The polish and scale of the build have made it a popular destination among VRChat's club and dance community.
